ruleDefinitions.name: AADInternals PowerShell Cmdlets Execution - ProccessCreation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects ADDInternals Cmdlet execution. A tool for administering Azure AD and Office 365. Which can be abused by threat actors to attack Azure AD or Office 365.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.Exe" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Add\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ConvertTo\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Disable\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Enable\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Export\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Find\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Get\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Grant\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Initialize\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Install\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Join\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*New\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Open\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Read\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Register\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Remove\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Reset\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Resolve\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Restore\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Save\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Search\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Send\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Set\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Start\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Unprotect\\-AADInt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Update\\-AADInt.*")))
